	<style>
		.crypto-quote {
			display: inline-flex;
			align-items: center;

			padding: 5px 10px;
			background: #f5f5f5;
			border-radius: 4px;
		}
		.crypto-symbol {
			font-weight: bold;
		}
		.crypto-price {
			color: #333;
			font-weight: 600;
		}
		.crypto-change.positive {
			color: #4caf50;
		}
		.crypto-change.negative {
			color: #f44336;
		}
		.popular-cryptos {
			margin: 20px 0;
		}
		.crypto-item {
			padding: 8px 0;
			border-bottom: 1px solid #eee;
		}
		.crypto-converter {
			padding: 10px;
			background: #f9f9f9;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			border-radius: 4px;
			display: inline-block;
		}
		.crypto-error {
			color: #f44336;
			padding: 10px;
			background: #ffebee;
			border-radius: 4px;
		}
	</style>
		<style>
		.fwp-stock-quote,
		.fwp-crypto-price,
		.fwp-index-quote {
			padding: 15px;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			border-radius: 5px;
			margin: 10px 0;
			background: #fff;
		}
		
		.fwp-quote-header,
		.fwp-crypto-header,
		.fwp-index-header {
			display: flex;
			justify-content: space-between;
			align-items: center;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}
		
		.fwp-symbol {
			font-weight: bold;
			font-size: 1.2em;
		}
		
		.fwp-price {
			font-size: 1.5em;
			font-weight: bold;
		}
		
		.fwp-change-amount.positive,
		.fwp-change-percent.positive,
		.positive {
			color: #0f9d58;
		}
		
		.fwp-change-amount.negative,
		.fwp-change-percent.negative,
		.negative {
			color: #d23f31;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers table {
			width: 100%;
			border-collapse: collapse;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers th,
		.fwp-market-movers td {
			padding: 8px;
			text-align: left;
			border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers th {
			background-color: #f5f5f5;
			font-weight: bold;
		}
		
		.fwp-indices-grid {
			display: grid;
			grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
			gap: 15px;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-card {
			padding: 15px;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			border-radius: 5px;
			background: #fff;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-name {
			font-weight: bold;
			margin-bottom: 5px;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-symbol {
			color: #666;
			font-size: 0.9em;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}
		
		.fwp-error {
			padding: 10px;
			background: #f8d7da;
			color: #721c24;
			border: 1px solid #f5c6cb;
			border-radius: 4px;
		}
	</style>

			padding: 15px;

			border-radius: 5px;
			margin: 10px 0;
			background: #fff;
		}

		.fwp-crypto-header,

			display: flex;
			justify-content: space-between;

			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}

			font-weight: bold;

		}

			font-size: 1.5em;
			font-weight: bold;
		}

			color: #0f9d58;

			border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;

			background-color: #f5f5f5;
			font-weight: bold;
		}

			margin-bottom: 10px;

			border: 1px solid #f5c6cb;
			border-radius: 4px;

		<style>
		.fwp-stock-quote,
		.fwp-crypto-price,
		.fwp-index-quote {
			padding: 15px;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			border-radius: 5px;
			margin: 10px 0;
			background: #fff;
		}
		
		.fwp-quote-header,
		.fwp-crypto-header,
		.fwp-index-header {
			display: flex;
			justify-content: space-between;
			align-items: center;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}
		
		.fwp-symbol {
			font-weight: bold;
			font-size: 1.2em;
		}
		
		.fwp-price {
			font-size: 1.5em;
			font-weight: bold;
		}
		
		.fwp-change-amount.positive,
		.fwp-change-percent.positive,
		.positive {
			color: #0f9d58;
		}
		
		.fwp-change-amount.negative,
		.fwp-change-percent.negative,
		.negative {
			color: #d23f31;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers table {
			width: 100%;
			border-collapse: collapse;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers th,
		.fwp-market-movers td {
			padding: 8px;
			text-align: left;
			border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
		}
		
		.fwp-market-movers th {
			background-color: #f5f5f5;
			font-weight: bold;
		}
		
		.fwp-indices-grid {
			display: grid;
			grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
			gap: 15px;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-card {
			padding: 15px;
			border: 1px solid #ddd;
			border-radius: 5px;
			background: #fff;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-name {
			font-weight: bold;
			margin-bottom: 5px;
		}
		
		.fwp-index-symbol {
			color: #666;
			font-size: 0.9em;
			margin-bottom: 10px;
		}
		
		.fwp-error {
			padding: 10px;
			background: #f8d7da;
			color: #721c24;
			border: 1px solid #f5c6cb;
			border-radius: 4px;
		}
